title: Comfort Club Per-Call Covered-Repair Cap for Long-Standing Members
content:
On the Comfort Club Maintenance Agreements tiers that include covered repairs, the most the covered-repair benefit pays on one service call is the tier's covered-repair per-incident cap, raised for long-standing members who have not drawn on the benefit recently.

## Per-call cap rule
- An agreement in at least its **tenth** consecutive term (a consecutive term count of 10 or more) with **no covered-repair draw dated within the 24 months** before the date of handling has the tier's per-incident cap raised by the long-standing cap increase of **250.00 USD**.
- An agreement in at least its **fifth** but fewer than its tenth consecutive term (a count of 5 to 9) with no such draw has that cap raised by the steady-member cap increase of **125.00 USD**.
- Any other agreement: no raise under this rule.

## Raised caps by tier

| Tier | Tier per-incident cap | Count 10 or more, no draw in 24 months | Count 5 to 9, no draw in 24 months |
|---|---|---|---|
| Comfort Club Platinum Plus | 750.00 | 1000.00 | 875.00 |
| Comfort Club Total Home | 1500.00 | 1750.00 | 1625.00 |

## Truth table

| Consecutive term count | Covered-repair draw dated within the 24 months before the date of handling | Raise |
|---|---|---|
| 10 or more | none | 250.00 |
| 10 or more | one or more | none |
| 5 to 9 | none | 125.00 |
| 5 to 9 | one or more | none |
| 4 or fewer | either | none |

## Points of judgement
- A count of exactly 10 meets "at least its tenth"; a count of exactly 5 meets "at least its fifth".
- A draw dated 23 months before the date of handling is within the 24 months and removes the raise.
